Series: Level up your protein!

As always, if you have any questions about the recipe or how to execute it, leave a comment and i will respond to help you out <3 

Nutrition: 
C: 47 | F: 8 | P: 37
Calories: 396 per serve
Serves 1

Ingredients
40 grams old fashioned rolled oats
200 ml almond / oats milk OR lactose free OR regular milk
40 grams plain Greek yogurt, 
1 scoop French vanilla  caramel protein powder + pinch of salt = salted caramel 💕
1 teaspoon chia seeds, optional
½ teaspoon vanilla extract, optional
pinch of sea salt
dusting of cocoa powder, optional 

Method
blend all ingredients together 
add to a bowl and leave in the fridge overnight
top with a little cocoa powder ( optional) and enjoy :)
